title: Horse eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <style>
      .horse { fill: #c98b5e; }
      .horse-light { fill: #e0aa7e; }
      .horse-dark { fill: #a86a44; }
      .mane { fill: #5b3a2a; }
      .hoof { fill: #7a4f33; }
      .hay { fill: #f2c94c; }
      .hay-light { fill: #f9e08a; }
      .grass { fill: #4cae4f; }
      .grass-light { fill: #7ed37a; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='7' fill='#3d8f3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='36' ry='5' fill='#4cae4f'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='62' width='8' height='26' rx='3' class='horse'/>
  <rect x='26' y='82' width='8' height='6' rx='2' class='hoof'/>
  <rect x='40' y='64' width='8' height='24' rx='3' class='horse-dark'/>
  <rect x='40' y='82' width='8' height='6' rx='2' class='hoof'/>
  <rect x='60' y='64' width='8' height='24' rx='3' class='horse-dark'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='8' height='6' rx='2' class='hoof'/>

  <rect x='72' y='82' width='8' height='6' rx='2' class='hoof'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='54' rx='26' ry='16' class='horse'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='18' ry='8' class='horse-light'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M68 48 Q76 40 82 26 Q88 30 84 44 Q80 54 74 58 Z' class='horse'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M82 26 Q86 20 90 24 Q88 32 84 40 Q86 34 84 28 Z' class='mane'/>
  <path d='M78 30 Q82 24 85 28 Q83 36 80 42 Z' class='mane'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='48' rx='12' ry='14' class='horse'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='46' rx='8' ry='9' class='horse-light'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M76 36 L74 26 L80 34 Z' class='horse'/>
  <path d='M76 34 L75 29 L78 34 Z' class='horse-dark'/>
  <path d='M88 34 L90 24 L92 34 Z' class='horse'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='88.8' cy='43.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nostril / muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='94' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2.5' class='horse-dark'/>

  <!-- hay snack in front of mouth -->
  <rect x='86' y='56' width='10' height='4' rx='2' class='hay'/>
  <rect x='88' y='60' width='9' height='3' rx='1.5' class='hay-light'/>
  <path d='M96 58 L102 54' stroke='#f2c94c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M96 60 L103 59' stroke='#f9e08a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M95 62 L101 63' stroke='#f2c94c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 48 Q16 44 14 54 Q18 52 20 56 Q16 60 22 62 Q24 56 26 56 Z' class='mane'/>
